translation.name: GOT WENG ABEM Alokso Abino Kalin

content: Yesus tá mataminsa umi sung uta ko.
Kale kamakikiw am dánámin wik kutim midiliw wanang alew iyo ilim gidgid kunin nin fako dawti sidiw uyo kudew nadiwade Yesus dau sidiw tum tem uniw.
Kale yak somone tum kudew yak awsom ati sidiw namti, kukan keidiw tum tem daung kalebu ka, kalesiw.
Kata ika yak tum tem tam nadiwade Kamok Yesus ami dam uyo utamin dakosiw.
Kale ika aket yumyum fukan bom tod áliwo mew bo wabising kinim alew mak ilim lukluk soim be kudák tane tad wanang min madano todiwe,

wanang min iyo fingán bom kin lukluk kuwáyamu kin kuwo bakan di kin mo aliwe, kinim alew iyo itam nadiwade bakoyam, “kiwta, kiba watawo kale kinim talá tabe bá, ayo fikalesiw imi iwyak tem kadákal fen kábiwe?
Aka kadák be bá, aka talá tabeba. Kale kiba Galili bakan kiwso bom nada weng bakoyamsa so fukan dá bidiwe?” Aka kale bakosa.
“‘Got ami Kinim ayo dabadáliw yak ban keimin kinim sikal ban dim abane as dim anak dádiwe am alewbino kei asiki talá tabokaba.’ Yakeisa.” Yakane,
ika am weng kalesa uyo aket finang dá madiw kalesiw ko.
Kale beta ika tum tem uyo kudá tad nadiwade kanomin sung adikum uyo Yesus alam nikil kum kal so wanang kinim madik so bakoyamsiw.
Kale wanang iyo Madiya Makdala kayak so Yoana so Madiya Yemis akun keidu wanang madik keidiw, ita tad weng dew kámin kinim iyo bakoyamsiw ko.
Kata im weng bakayabiw bo ika afano kalongin banim, bo sák ilim weng bakanbiwo, yakeisiw.
Kata Bita ata mew bo biyakuda ki un bi yak tum tem tam kaek fenomane, ilim falal dau daubiw kuw bu ka. Kale nadale alo asiki tadan bom nadale aket tet tad bom bo yaknobane kalansa ko.
Imeas abiw leiw eibisiw umi sung uta ko.

Kale am makuw dánámin kabadák ki Yesus ibik tei kámin kinim alew mak iyo abiw win Imeas kalbiw, unumo kale unsidiw. Kale imi unsidiw be Yedusalem kalo dák Imeas abiw unemin leiw be atin sikam bá, mewso ko.
Kale alew leiw ei bom nadiwade kanomin kukuw adikum Yesus kanadawsiw sung uyo alew bakodawa bakodawa abemsiw.
Kale alew weng bakam ei bom nadiwade kanobano kalin sung bakam ei bom keimiwe, Yesus ayo tad kim lukoda nikil iso ei bom keimsa.
Kata atam madiw kale alatano kalongin banim falak atiyamano kayo ko.
Aka dákadá bakoyam, “kiba wataw sung uta leiw bakodawa bakodawa keim tadanbiwe?” Yakane, ika eibiw kuw tod nadiwe amanuk kin bá nadiwe
kinim mak ami win Kiliyobas aka dákadálaw, “Yedusalem biyámin kinim be makuw kawta kuw memak mew amsin kanodin kukuw kanamsu bo kal keidongin banim emak?” Akane,

Asik aka bakodaw, “yaknámin sung utana?” Yakane, ika weng fakadu bakodaw, “Yesus Nasadet kayak ami sung uyo, aka lum senin kinim ade Got kin dim so wanang kinim adikum im kin dim so aka kitid soim weng bakanin ade ami kanamin be kidel kitid tabesa kale.
Bokal kayak as fakiw dákadáwin kinim so num kin modin kinim so iyo dabadáliw yak wasi sikal ban dim aba weng gudula dau anbidumo kale nadiwade as dawing dákamin dim sil biki anbisidiw,
kata num mimin dok diyámin bo ata Isadael wanang kinim iyo min talá imadálokabano, kalesuw. Kata bo kanodawiw bi am alewbinon keida kala.
Kaleyo kamane kutim wanang nuluso kámin iyo aket diking dakungin weng mak bakoyabiw. Kale be ika yak fom lung tum tem nadiwe,
Yesus ami dam uyo banim ka. Kale ika tad bakoyam nadiwade, ‘nuka ensel itamuwo,’ ika bakoyam, ‘Yesus aka kaunsin be kala.’ Yakiw taduwo.” Yakeibiw kayo ko.
“Kata alo kanamin weng be kidi nadiwo num kinim madik iyo ilita yak tum tem yak nadiwe utamomo, wanang ilim weng bakodiw taw, utamsiw, kata Yesus alami be atamongin danim.”
Kaliwe, beta Yesus asik bakoyam, “kinimá kana bom be kinim ken bisune, kiba lum senin kinim im weng bakamsiw uyo afano kalongin banim, aket lumlumbiw buyo.
Got Walusa Kinim aka kanamin mámin yáw bo dakadu nadale tam alam lamlam tem so unono kalesa.”
Kale Yesus aka alam sung godusiw umi mit kei daka fi bom bakayamsa uyo Mosus ami godusa kalo bakam una ki adikum lum senin kinim madik im godusiw so adik mit kilá bakayamsa.
Kale ika tad bi tad abiw wol bán ilim abiw unumo kale tadbiw mewso nadiwe Yesus aka alam kanom be ki fokfok unono kalin taw keidane,
ika kitid tabe dawtaman bom nadiwe bakodaw, “bá, am kuinba bede kalakal nikil sino kala tadbu leiw so wakadámin bá.” Kaliwe, afan aka nikil kal sumo, kalesa.
Kale bude aka wanin wanin bán kal dim nikil tein nadiwade imin budet bo kudu nadale, Got keno kale nadane fakel fakel geleyamono kanama,
ika falak atiyaba, kale ika kin bá kama aket fukan bom alam kin gubu finang dákan tadiwe, ilim iwyak tem kadák kal banimano,
ika alew bakodawa bakodawa bom bakodiw “kuin leiw bo tad bom nadale Got godin weng kale bakosuno kal bom bakayam tad bada num aket dafoyama taduwano.”
Kalbiw ade wabising asiki Yedusalem uniw. Kale ika tad Yesus nikil kum kal keidiw wanang kinim madik keidiw, nikil tada tada dek amki
nadiwade bakodiw, “atin afan tá, Kamok Yesus ayo talá tabe nadale Saimon dim kal misunba.” Kal bom keimiwe,
beta kinim alew iyo ilim leiw ei bidiw kanodu sung so Yesus imin budet fako dawkana kin gubu finang dákaniw kalo maklo keida sung so uyo bakoyamsidiw ko.
Yesus alam nikil dim misunase umi sung uta ko.
Kale kanamin sung bo baka bom keim áliwo mew bo Yesus kuw tad iwyak kulel kala ka, kaliwe, aka bakoyam “aket dakbuyámin uyo kiwso badano kala.”
Kalane, ika aket banbin dok teiyama fingán bom nadiwade im aket bo sawkal mak atamuw kalaniwe,
aka bakoyam, “watawo kale aket yumyum fukan bom nadiwe watawo kale aket fingán bom kanabiwa?
Kala tad nam tenga yána sil gu bo utam nadiwo atin afan alatane. Kalino, maek malenam natamine, sawkal ika kano nalataw dam so kun so bá!” Yakeisa.
Kale aka weng be bakoyama banimane, aka teng so yán so kukuyamane,
ika kalfalin dukum uyo kuduliw, kata afan kalongin danim keidiwe, aka bakoyam, “wanin so mak wanumo dawtidiw bene?” Yakane,
ika takam kainin but mak kudawiwe,
aka kudu nadale ilimi kin dim kadákal wanesa kate.

Aka bakoyam, “bela nalam dil kibiliwso alom nadi bakoyamsi, adikum bo kanodokabuno, kale suwayo weng kudew maek nalamal tei Mosus so lum senin kinim so Fuw Buk tem umi weng bakosiw dam namti, abusu ka.”
Kalese uyo aka im aket bakel dauyamano utam Got godin weng bakosu beta mak aket finang dádin kala kale nadano bakosa.
Kale aka bako, “Got ami godin weng uyo bakosu kai, Got Walusa Kinim aka mámin yáw dákadu nadale fom lung kal bi am alewbino kei nadano talá tabokaba.
Kale Yedusalem kalo as bakadá kung kutamo bakan adikum kuw tabodu uyo ban keimin ibik dumamámin weng so ban keimin lukuwá kudámin weng so uyo bakanin kala.
Kale kiba adikum ufek ufek nam kanamsi umi kin walamin kinim kei sidiw kale,

naka Natim alam weng boyam dauyamokabi, kalesa uyo dabadáyami tadokaba. Kata kiba yak maekin bá, alam Yedusalem kadák ki aing gei dausidiwo katamo abid tikino kitid uyo madák kiwa imsáwil moduno kala.” Kalesa ko.
Yesus tamansa umi sung uta ko.
Kale bela Yesus ayo imadew Betani abiw mewso leiw unom nadale teng kufoda abid unune,
beta aka im kinim dákaba kaokal gid kuw kaú kalano kalomo imadá tamba ka.
Kale bude kabadákal win kufádaw bom nadiwade asiki leiw yáw leiw kuw kalfalin so Yedusalem tasiw ko.
Kale ika sun kuw Yol am bom nadiwe Got win kufádawsiw ko.
